items.title: Christian Watson: Held in check by Vikes
items.text:
Watson caught three of five targets for 37 yards in Sunday's 30-10 loss to Minnesota.

items.title: Geno Smith: Status for Week 11 uncertain
items.text:
Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said after Sunday's loss to Buffalo that Smith, who departed the contest due to an ankle injury, will have his status for Week 11 determined during the upcoming week of practice, Jack Bell of the Jets' official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Dalton Kincaid: Gains 58 yards on three targets
items.text:

items.title: Jordan Love: Buried by Minnesota pass rush in loss
items.text:
Love completed 17 of 27 passes for 220 yards and a touchdown with an interception in Sunday's 30-10 loss to the Vikings.

items.title: DJ Moore: Scores 45-yard TD in Week 10 win
items.text:
Moore caught four of six targets for 90 yards and a touchdown while rushing once for four yards in Sunday's 31-12 win over the Jets.
